clauses: Average each patient’s HGB/HCT ratios across lab records with both values.
Divide each patient’s average HGB by their average HCT.
readings: Looking at each patient's hemoglobin-to-hematocrit (`HGB`/`HCT`) ratio from their lab records (ignoring missing values), take the patients whose ratio is above the average across all patients. Give one summary row for them: the mean of their average PIC, the mean of their ratios, and the mean amount by which their ratios exceed that cross-patient average. Average each patient’s HGB/HCT ratios across lab records with both values.

Looking at each patient's hemoglobin-to-hematocrit (`HGB`/`HCT`) ratio from their lab records (ignoring missing values), take the patients whose ratio is above the average across all patients. Give one summary row for them: the mean of their average PIC, the mean of their ratios, and the mean amount by which their ratios exceed that cross-patient average. Divide each patient’s average HGB by their average HCT.
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
                 THEN HGB / HCT END) AS avg_ratio,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
cross_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
    AVG(p.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(p.avg_ratio - c.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM patient_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN cross_patient_average AS c
WHERE p.avg_ratio > c.avg_ratio

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(HCT) AS avg_hct,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        avg_pic,
        avg_hgb / avg_hct AS ratio
    FROM patient_averages
    WHERE avg_hgb IS NOT NULL
      AND avg_hct IS NOT NULL
      AND avg_hct <> 0
),
cross_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_average_pic,
    AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(p.ratio - c.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio
FROM patient_ratios AS p
CROSS JOIN cross_patient_average AS c
WHERE p.ratio > c.avg_ratio
